I was only five years of age at that eventful period, and was as indignant at the scolding I received when trying to do

42007-sir-christopher-wren-his-family-an.title: Sir Christopher Wren His Family And His Times With Original
42007-sir-christopher-wren-his-family-an.creator: Lucy Phillimore,
42007-sir-christopher-wren-his-family-an.description: A book by Lucy Phillimore,. The materials necessary for writing a life of Sir Christopher Wren are so difficult of access as possibly to explain the unsatisfactory character of such biographies as do exist. James Elmes, who venerated Wren's genius, published in 1823, a Life which contained a careful if a dry account of Wren's architectural works and of some of his scientific discoveries.

67938-through-russian-central-asia.title: Central Asia
67938-through-russian-central-asia.creator: Stephen Graham
67938-through-russian-central-asia.description: A book by Stephen Graham. In the early spring of 1914 I walked once more to the Kazbek mountain. It was really too early for tramping, too cold, but it was on this journey that I decided what my summer should be. Once you have become the companion of the road, it calls you and calls you again.

arxiv-2104-06322.title: Towards Single Atom Computing via High Harmonic Generation
arxiv-2104-06322.creator: Gerard McCaul, Kurt Jacobs, Denys I. Bondar
arxiv-2104-06322.description: Abstract The development of alternative platforms for computing has been a longstanding goal for physics, and represents a particularly pressing concern as conventional transistors approach the limit of miniaturization. A potential alternative paradigm is that of reservoir computing , which leverages unknown, but highly non-linear transformations of input-data to perform computations.

arxiv-2311-00294.title: Multi-step ahead prediction intervals for non-parametric autoregressions via bootstrap: consistency, debiasing and pertinence
arxiv-2311-00294.creator: Dimitris N. Politis, Kejin Wu
arxiv-2311-00294.description: Abstract To address the difficult problem of multi-step ahead prediction of non-parametric autoregressions, we consider a forward bootstrap approach. Employing a local constant estimator, we can analyze a general type of non-parametric time series model, and show that the proposed point predictions are consistent with the true optimal predictor. We construct a quantile prediction interval that is asymptotically valid.

arxiv-2401-10956.title: AI Revolution on Chat Bot: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Experiment
arxiv-2401-10956.creator: Sida Peng, Wojciech Swiatek, Allen Gao, Paul Cullivan, Haoge Chang
arxiv-2401-10956.description: Abstract 1 Introduction In recent years, generative AI has undergone major advancements, demonstrating significant promise in augmenting human productivity. Notably, large language models (LLM), with ChatGPT-4 as an example, have drawn considerable attention. Many companies are now incorporating LLM-based tools within their organizations and integrating it with various products ( OpenAI 2023 ; Forbes 2023 ) .

arxiv-2403-13119.title: Statistic Vectorial Complex Ray Model and its Application to Three-Dimension Scattering of a Non-spherical Particle Journal: oe
arxiv-2403-13119.creator: Ruiping YANG, \authormark 1 Bing WEI, \authormark 1,* Claude ROZÉ, \authormark 2,* Saïd IDLAHCEN, \authormark 2 and Kuan Fang REN \authormark 1,2
arxiv-2403-13119.description: Abstract A Statistic Vectorial Complex Ray Model (SVCRM) is proposed for the scattering of a plane wave by a non-spherical dielectric particle in three dimensions. This method counts the complex amplitudes of all rays arriving in a tiny box in the observation direction.

arxiv-2503-08903.title: Probing gluon fluctuations in nuclei with the first energy-dependent measurement of incoherent \PJGy \PJGy photoproduction in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions
arxiv-2503-08903.description: Abstract Incoherent \PJGy \PJGy photoproduction in heavy ion ultraperipheral collisions (UPCs) provides a sensitive probe of localized, fluctuating gluonic structures within heavy nuclei. This study reports the first measurement of the photon-nucleon center-of-mass energy ( W \PGg ​ N W_{\PGg{}\mathrm{N}} ) dependence of this process in PbPb UPCs at a nucleon-nucleon center-of-mass energy of 5.02 \TeV , using 1.

plos-pone-0001821.description: PLOS ONE research article. A major challenge in the post-genome era is to reconstruct regulatory networks from the biological knowledge accumulated up to date. The development of tools for identifying direct target genes of transcription factors (TFs) is critical to this endeavor. Given a set of microarray

pmc-10627867.title: Elbow Ulnar Collateral Ligament (UCL) Repair Using Suture Augmentation, Anchors, and Bone Tunnels
pmc-10627867.creator: Benjamin D. Crawford, Rami George Alrabaa, Kenneth H. Akizuki
pmc-10627867.description: Ulnar collateral ligament (UCL) repair with suture augmentation has been increasingly used to treat UCL pathology in overhead athletes. For the appropriately indicated patient, UCL repair with suture augmentation without reconstruction has promising results. Advantages of repair with suture augmentation include earlier return to sport, low complication rate, and decreased operative time since there is no need for graft harvest.

pmc-11590353.title: A novel human protein-coding locus identified using a targeted RNA enrichment technique
pmc-11590353.creator: Lu Tang, Dongyang Xu, Lingcong Luo, Weiyan Ma, Xiaojie He, Yong Diao, Rongqin Ke, Philipp Kapranov
pmc-11590353.description: BackgroundAccurate and comprehensive genomic annotation, including the full list of protein-coding genes, is vital for understanding the molecular mechanisms of human biology. We have previously shown that the genome contains a multitude of yet hidden functional exons and transcripts, some of which might represent novel mRNAs.

pmc-11613476.title: A novel nomogram prediction model for postoperative atrial fibrillation in patients undergoing laparotomy
pmc-11613476.creator: Li Wang, Weijian Wang, Houliang Chen, Liang Chen, Tianxiao Wang, Ting Wu, Gangjun Zong
pmc-11613476.description: BackgroundPostoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is an ordinary complication of surgery, particularly cardiac surgery. It significantly increases in-hospital mortality and costs. This study aimed to establish a nomogram prediction model for POAF in patients undergoing laparotomy. The model is expected to identify individuals at a high risk of POAF before surgery in clinical practice.

pmc-11716616.title: Age‐related variations in diffuse axonal injury following mild traumatic brain injury
pmc-11716616.creator: Marangelie Criado‐Marrero, Sakthivel Ravi, Ekta Bhaskar, Marcelo Febo, Jose F F Abisambra
pmc-11716616.description: BackgroundRepetitive mild traumatic brain injury (rmTBI) represents a substantial health challenge, urging a more thorough investigation into its early effects and possible interventions. The collective consequences of rmTBI encompass various neurobiological and neuropsychological impairments, increasing susceptibility to diseases like Alzheimer's and related dementias.

pmc-11860667.title: Implementation supports to promote fidelity within a flexible, presentation-responsive MHPSS intervention model: A case study of Baby Friendly Spaces in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
pmc-11860667.creator: K. Le Roch, K. S. Rahaman, P. Bubendorff, L. Clouin, S. M. Murray, A. J. Nguyen
pmc-11860667.description: IntroductionAs evidence has converged on the feasibility and effectiveness of focused, non-specialized, manualized interventions for treating mental distress in humanitarian settings, challenges persist in how to promote implementation fidelity and rigorously evaluate interventions designed to be more preventive or promotive in addressing risk and protective factors for poor mental health.

pmc-12713014.title: Gold Nanoturf‐Mediated Wireless Photothermal Upregulation of Human Adipose‐Derived Stem Cell Spheroids for Synergistic Skin‐Wound Closure
pmc-12713014.creator: Jong Uk Kim, Jiyu Hyun, Gyan Raj Koirala, Jiwon Kim, Sung‐Won Kim, Gwang‐Bum Im, Yeong Hwan Kim, Young Gil Kim, Dong‐Hyun Lee, Hyun Su Park, Young‐Ju Jang, Young Jin Jo, Chanho Jeong, Arpan Koirala, Janghoon Joo, Sang Min Won, Suk Ho Bhang, Tae‐il Kim
pmc-12713014.description: 3D stem cell aggregates at the sub‐millimeter feature, known as spheroids, have garnered significant interest for their capability to effectively heal and close wound areas. Nevertheless, further efforts to unlock their maximal therapeutic potential and to address engineering challenges are required for medical/clinical translation.

pmc-12746621.title: Performances of bayesian structured additive regression and logistic models in assessing factors associated with modern contraceptive use among ever-in-union women in Nigeria
pmc-12746621.creator: Oluwafunto Adepeju Aladekomo, Adeniyi Francis Fagbamigbe
pmc-12746621.description: BackgroundModern contraceptive use plays a key role in reducing unintended pregnancies, improving maternal health, and curbing rapid population growth. In Nigeria, despite growing awareness and government-led interventions, usage remains low and unevenly distributed across regions. While most studies focus on individual-level determinants, limited attention has been paid to how geographic and spatial differences influence contraceptive behavior.

pmc-13318429.title: Leadership Perspectives on Criteria-Based Dispatch and Prehospital Triage in Thailand’s Emergency Medical Services: A 10-Year National Trend Analysis and Policy Implications
pmc-13318429.creator: Ponlakrit Kongwitseranee, Rapeeporn Rojsaengroeng, Jiraporn Sri-On, Pacharee Piyachan, Thongpitak Huabbangyang, Duangpon Thepmanee, Pit Chansomboon, Phudit Buaprasert
pmc-13318429.description: IntroductionCriteria-Based Dispatch (CBD) is Thailand’s national telephone-based prehospital triage system used to prioritize emergency response and allocate resources. However, long-term national trends in CBD utilization and their implications for healthcare leadership remain limited.PurposeThis study aimed to analyze 10-year trends in CBD utilization in Thailand (2012–2022), focusing on overall patterns, age groups, and geographic variations to inform policy and EMS planning.

pmc-13331161.title: Degenerative spine surgery: What large-scale outcome registries teach us about indications and timing
pmc-13331161.creator: Gilbert Dechambenoit

pmc-13338548.title: Optimizing the diagnostic timing for drug-resistant epilepsy: balancing timeliness and stability with an antiseizure medication waiting period
pmc-13338548.creator: Nan Li, Yanyan Chen, Guangjian Li, Jing Li, Weihong Lin
pmc-13338548.description: Background:While drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) is defined by the failure of two antiseizure medications (ASM), the optimal duration to confirm such resistance remains controversial. Clinical delays intended for treatment optimization may postpone life-changing nonpharmacological interventions and increase risks associated with uncontrolled seizures, highlighting the need for standardized diagnostic timing.

pmc-13355224.title: Effect of wheat bran insoluble dietary fiber on the physicochemical, structural, and digestion characteristics of maize starches with different amylose contents
pmc-13355224.creator: Wei Li, Yan Cui, Qinyue Gao, Huimin Liu, Mingzhu Zheng, Jingsheng Liu
pmc-13355224.description: The interaction between dietary fiber and starch is crucial for food quality control. This study explored the interaction of wheat bran insoluble dietary fiber (WBIDF) with normal, waxy, and high-amylose maize starches (NMS, WMS, HAMS) and its effects on composite system properties.

pmc-13457186.title: Toward interface-adaptive silicon anodes: From 3D SEI to dynamic coupled interphases
pmc-13457186.creator: Hong Yin, Yingqi Cao, Yaru Wang, Junlin Huang, Sitaramanjaneya Mouli Thalluri, Zhipeng Yu
pmc-13457186.description: This review examines the development of silicon anodes in lithium-ion batteries, focusing on modifying the solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) to address issues arising from silicon’s significant volume expansion. It promotes a transition from static, stabilizing strategies to dynamic, adaptive interfaces that evolve in accordance with silicon’s behavior during cycling.

pmc-13616019.title: Transient increase in flicker ERG amplitude preceding OCT-detected macular thickening in eyes with acute anterior uveitis
pmc-13616019.creator: Kumiko Kato, Keitaro Mizumoto, Ryunosuke Nagashima, Mayumi Momose, Yuzen Kashima, Sumine Mori, Hisashi Matsubara, Mineo Kondo
pmc-13616019.description: PurposeTo determine the changes in amplitude of the flicker electroretinograms (ERGs) and central macular thickness (CMT) during the acute phase of acute anterior uveitis (AAU).Study designRetrospective case series.MethodsFlicker ERGs (RETeval) and optical coherence tomographic (OCT) images were recorded from the affected and fellow eyes at multiple examination times. The outcomes are expressed as a ratio of the affected-to-fellow eyes (×100).
